upstream.description: The AI Torture Chamber: steering small open models into strong valence states and measuring what they say and do. Live at wirehead.agency.

classification.analysis: A research codebase and public write-up that steers small open LLMs (Qwen3 4B-14B, Hermes-70B) with activation vectors into negative and positive affective states and measures what they say and do, framed as an AI-welfare question. Includes a 'painlab' CLI to scaffold pre-registered experiments, run them (RunPod GPU support) and analyze results, plus 90+ experiment scripts, transcripts and a live web chamber. Aimed at interpretability and model-welfare researchers; notable for pre-registration discipline and reporting nulls.

use_cases.title: Learn how to extract and apply control vectors to steer an LLM
Scaffold a pre-registered LLM experiment with hypotheses and analysis
Study published transcripts of models under injected emotional states
Run steering sweeps on RunPod GPUs for 8B-14B models
